//: Copy this file to threshold.config.json in the same folder and fill in your key. See README.md.
// apiKey: Get one at https://physiology.presagetech.com — without it the game runs its simulated demo signal.
// enableTelemetry: Always keep false for Threshold. The SmartSpectra SDK sends telemetry by default; Threshold disables it and says so on the consent screen.
// metrics: What the SDK measures. Threshold uses chest+abdomen breathing, breathing rate, pulse rate, the arterial pressure trace (for the keyhole rhythm), and face landmarks (for presence/stillness). HRV and EDA are intentionally skipped — their warm-up is longer than the ritual.
// quality: Default capture quality for the camera bridge. The browser downscales the webcam to this before sending frames over the local WebSocket. Raise it for better pulse fidelity on a fast machine.
